scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate:local: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs npx wrangler d1 migrations apply rgboo-organizer-local --local
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:staging && node scripts/write-deploy-secrets.mjs main && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs npx wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --secrets-file .wrangler/generated/main-secrets.json
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:production && node scripts/write-deploy-secrets.mjs main && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs npx wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --secrets-file .wrangler/generated/main-secrets.json
scripts.deploy:jobs:staging: node scripts/prepare-jobs-config.mjs staging && node scripts/write-deploy-secrets.mjs jobs && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs npx wrangler deploy --config .wrangler/generated/jobs-wrangler.json --secrets-file .wrangler/generated/jobs-secrets.json
scripts.deploy:jobs:production: node scripts/prepare-jobs-config.mjs production && node scripts/write-deploy-secrets.mjs jobs && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs npx wrangler deploy --config .wrangler/generated/jobs-wrangler.json --secrets-file .wrangler/generated/jobs-secrets.json
